d:
IM Aradhya Garg scored his 1st GM Norm at the Atyrau Open 2026. He scored 6/9 points, beating players like GM Kazybek Nogerbek and GM Pranav Anand, and in the final round, he needed to win against Arkadij Naiditsch, and he did that on Demand.
We caught up with Aradhya at the 1st Chola Chess International Open 2026, where he analysed his final-round win at the Atyrau Open and discussed his journey and the Chola Foundation.
Interview and Edited by: Devansh Singh
